summary: Luda Technology Group Limited filed a Form 6-K on May 19, 2026, announcing the appointment of authorized agents in Brazil, Colombia, Bolivia, Ecuador, and Malaysia. This is a routine business update regarding global expansion, not a special situation. The press release details new agent partnerships (exclusive and non-exclusive) to strengthen sales networks. No financial terms, share transactions, or board actions are involved. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16. As a non-US registrant, this 6-K equates to a US current report of material events, but here the event is ordinary business development with no corporate action meeting special-situation criteria.
